process.title: Systematic execution from site constraints to handover
process.lead: Our technical workflow ensures that planning, structural engineering, and secondary trades progress under strict site discipline.

steps.title: Pre-Construction Coordination
steps.body: Aligning project quantities, structural requirements, and site constraints before deploying machinery and personnel to the field.

steps.title: Engineering & TCE Control
steps.body: Coordinating structural calculations, MEP routing, and secondary trades within a unified all-trades delivery (TCE) framework.

steps.title: Site Execution & Massing
steps.body: Managing daily concrete pours, structural framing, masonry, and trade sequencing under the direct supervision of our site managers.

steps.title: Quality, Safety & Schedule Monitoring
steps.body: Verifying material compliance, structural tolerances, and safety protocols against contractual milestones and Algerian building codes.

steps.title: Handover & Technical Closeout
steps.body: Finalising as-built documentation, commissioning building systems, and executing formal handover to the client.

about.title: Technical capability and structured site management
paragraphs: Founded in 2018 and led by civil engineer Adem Talay, SARL Igloo Yapi Construction operates from Bir Khadem, Algiers, specialising in residential and mixed-use developments across Algeria.
Holding a Category 6 Professional Qualification and Classification Certificate, the firm maintains an in-house technical office comprising civil engineers, architects, and site managers.

proofs.title: Residential & Mixed-use Expertise
proofs.body: Housing, villas, commercial premises, roads, networks, services and exterior works.

footprint.title: Regional operations across northern Algeria
footprint.lead: Eleven projects distributed across four key wilayas, establishing a strong operational presence in Algiers, Tipaza, Boumerdes, and Mostaganem.
